• 2026-11-21

    Hacked target: Aramid Bridge

    Description of the event: On November 21, 2026, Aramid Bridge’s Base bridge contract was exploited via a signature-replay bug. The attacker reused the same valid signature multiple times to withdraw assets, minting large amounts of unbacked aVOI that were redeemed for real assets. Bridging is paused and Algorand/Voi escrows have been rekeyed. No private keys, multisig, or signer infrastructure were compromised.

    Amount of loss: $ 8500 Attack method: Signature Replay Bug

  • 2026-11-19

    Hacked target: CALC

    Description of the event: CALC (a DeFi DCA tools protocol) suffered near-total drainage of its operational treasury held in a Keplr hot wallet due to a Web3Auth social-login infrastructure vulnerability that exposed signing credentials; only a tiny portion was identified for recovery.

    Amount of loss: $ 26,900 Attack method: Private Key Leakage

    View Reference Sources

  • 2026-11-16

    Hacked target: MORE Markets

    Description of the event: MORE Markets, a lending protocol deployed on Flow EVM, was exploited due to a bug in its lending contract liquidation logic. An attacker used flash loans to open and self-liquidate positions in the ankrFLOW/WFLOW market. A flaw cleared the collateral without clearing the corresponding WFLOW debt, allowing withdrawals from the WFLOW reserve. Losses were approximately $308,000; the protocol has been paused, with impact limited to users who supplied WFLOW to that market.

    Amount of loss: $ 308000 Attack method: Smart Contract Vulnerability
